### Heritage Financial Announces Earnings Release Date and Conference Call


September 30, 2026


OLYMPIA, Wash.


, Sept. 30, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Heritage Financial Corporation (Nasdaq: HFWA) (the "Company" or "Heritage") anticipates issuing its third quarter earnings release on Thursday, October 22, 2026 before the market opens. The Company has scheduled a conference call to discuss the third quarter earnings on Thursday, October 22, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. Pacific time (12:00 p.m. Eastern time). There will be a live question-and-answer session following the presentation.


Participants may register for the call using the link below to receive dial-in details and their own unique dial-in code. It is recommended you join 10 minutes prior to the start time. Register for the call with the below link:


[https://events.q4inc.com/analyst/562330083?pwd=MlXLXIj8](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786833-1&h=3847697838&u=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fanalyst%2F562330083%3Fpwd%3DMlXLXIj8&a=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fanalyst%2F562330083%3Fpwd%3DMlXLXIj8)


You may also access the conference call utilizing the numbers listed below:


Live Conference Call


(833) 461-5787


Meeting ID: 562 330 083


The conference call will be recorded and will dialing (833) 309-1852 for replay twenty-four hours a day ending November 5, 2026. The recording can also be found on the Company website at[www.hf-wa.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786833-1&h=2058725513&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.hf-wa.com%2F&a=www.hf-wa.com) .


Questions regarding the conference call may be directed to Kaylene Lahn at 360-943-1500.


**About Heritage Financial** Heritage Financial Corporation is an Olympia-based bank holding company with Heritage Bank, a full-service commercial bank, as its sole wholly-owned banking subsidiary. Heritage Bank has banking offices in Washington, Oregon, and Idaho. Heritage Bank also does business under the Whidbey Island Bank name on Whidbey Island and the Kitsap Bank name for branches acquired in the Company's merger with Olympic Bancorp, Inc. Heritage's stock is traded on the NASDAQ Global Select Market under the symbol "HFWA". More information about Heritage Financial Corporation can be found on its website at[www.hf-wa.com](http://www.hf-wa.com/) and more information about Heritage Bank can be found on its website at[www.heritagebanknw.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786833-1&h=3781436617&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.heritagebanknw.com%2F&a=www.heritagebanknw.com) .
